nina: heads up — deploy-bot auto-rollback triggered for the web-api canary at 09:07 UTC citing increased error_rate on /v1/query.
deploy-bot: autopilot: detected error_rate > 1.5% for 5m; rolling back to v2.14.0. Rollout 0xdef4.
oscar: grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/klm quick glance shows errors concentrated in two hosts, suspect network flakiness.
sre-bot: infra alert: netlink flaps detected on host-group C in eu-central-1 at 09:06 UTC.
nina: propose we pause further autopilot actions, pin the rollout to prevent ramp, and validate whether rollback is necessary. If dedicated pools affected -> immediate manual rollback.
oscar: agreed. pausing autopilot now. @deploy-bot pause 0xdef4 20m
deploy-bot: command accepted: autopilot paused for rollout 0xdef4 (20m). To force rollback: `deploy-bot rollback 0xdef4 --force`.
nina: checking Sentry for user-facing impact.
oscar: Sentry shows retries increased but <0.2% of overall traffic. dedicated pools unaffected.
nina: decision: keep pinned, monitor 15m, owners: oscar (infra), nina (eng), escalate if error_rate > 1% sustained for 10m. I'll draft a short internal note.
oscar: will investigate host-group C, will report findings in 10m.
deploy-bot: rollout 0xdef4 pinned (pin-id: pin-1207). Autopilot remains paused.
sre-bot: created incident RL-1350 assigned to oscar. Escalation window 30m.
nina: thanks team — reopening if we hit the threshold or need to execute manual rollback.
